facts.text: Tern keeps composer draft state in `PiTernBridge` as the `#draft` accessor (get/set), and editing is done by `DraftEditor`, which tracks UTF-16 `text`/`cursor`/`selection`. Composer nodes are built by `composerNodes` in `.pi/lib/tern/composer-view.ts`, which the bridge calls with `draft: this.#draft`.

`.pi/lib/tern/composer-view.ts` sets the composer placeholder to `"What are we cooking?"` (checked by `.pi/test/tern/dock.test.ts`). `contextThresholds` returns warn at 50% or 150,000 tokens and bad at 90% or 500,000 tokens, whichever is smaller, matching the comment's OMP `uPn()` reference.

Tern's `picker` node (`k: "picker"`) is used for the model selector (`model-picker-sheet`) and the session-tree picker (`session-tree-picker`). Its data is `p.items`, `order`, `selected`, and `query`. Activate and select events are handled in `PiTernBridge.handle` on `verb === "e"`.

Bootstrap caps selected skills at `MAX_BOOTSTRAP_SKILLS = 2` and inline skill delivery at `MAX_BOOTSTRAP_SKILL_DELIVERY_CHARS = 12000` UTF-16 units. Longer skill text is truncated with a marker, and the full text is written to a `mode: 0o600` temp file that the model reads in chunks.
`boundSelection` in `packages/runtime/bootstrap/src/orchestrator.ts` caps memories at 8 items and 1200 chars each, skill bodies at 4000 chars, and evidence at 20 entries.

The bootstrap feature is split between `extensions/bootstrap/extension.ts`, which imports from `packages/runtime/bootstrap/src/index.ts`, and the runtime package `packages/runtime/bootstrap/src/` (`orchestrator.ts`, `consult.ts`, `store.ts`).
`.pi/lib/tern/run.ts` falls back to native pi with the reason `"stdin is not a tty"` when `stdin.isTTY` is false, so the Tern UI requires a TTY.
